mapper.insert: INSERT INTO c2k_review (id, tenant_id, candidate_id, digest, submitter_id, reviewer_id, method, request_id) VALUES (#{value.id}, #{value.tenantId}, #{value.candidateId}, #{value.digest}, #{value.submitterId}, #{value.reviewerId}, #{value.method}, #{value.requestId})
mapper.update: UPDATE c2k_review SET state = #{value.state}, comment = #{value.comment}, revision = revision + 1, decided_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE tenant_id = #{value.tenantId} AND id = #{value.id} AND reviewer_id = #{value.reviewerId} AND revision = #{value.revision} AND state = 'PENDING'
